valid_implementation_failure.title: Normal child exit before exec is mistaken for a successful CLOEXEC acknowledgement
valid_implementation_failure.evidence: Replacing supervisor child os.execvpe with os._exit(72) produces EXEC_READY, EXPERIMENT_START, MAIN_RETURN:72, LIFETIME_DONE, and INPUT_BARRIER in Bash/sh although the payload marker is absent. lifecycle.py accepts cached numeric exit after EOF and rejects only signaled exits.
valid_implementation_failure.required_correction: Treat exec acknowledgement as successful only when EOF is not paired with any pre-exec child wait status; fail UNKNOWN/EXEC_ERROR for normal or signaled pre-exec exit and never emit experiment start or completion facts.

passing_independent_coverage: Foreground read-back failure keeps the child prepared and prevents experiment start.
Missing or wrong exec event fails closed.
Literal argv and script requests avoid parent reinterpretation.
Supervisor/control loss becomes UNKNOWN and blocks replay.
